demos.name: AccordionUsage
demos.description: - Accordion: the wrapper for grouping related components.

demos.name: AccordionExpandIcon
demos.description: Use the expandIcon prop on the Accordion Summary component to change the expand indicator icon.

demos.name: AccordionExpandDefault
demos.description: Use the defaultExpanded prop on the Accordion component to have it opened by default.

demos.name: AccordionTransition
demos.description: Use the slots.transition and slotProps.transition props to change the Accordion's default transition.

demos.name: DisabledAccordion
demos.description: Use the disabled prop on the Accordion component to disable interaction and focus.

demos.name: ControlledAccordions
demos.description: The Accordion component can be controlled or uncontrolled.
